kept operates on a corpus of artifacts and local state that
live next to your project files stored in a git workspace
the corpus is a graph of authored markdown
kept tracks an artifact's standing and truth
- standing - does this specific version of an
artifact obligate the project to do something?
- truth - is this specific version of an artifact,
in a specific working tree meeting expectations?
